home.subtitle: It all began the day we decided never to let go
home.caption: featured memory — coming soon
home.proposal: Our whole story began on that January 3rd, but our love story began the day I finally asked the question I had waited so long to ask: Would you grant me the immense privilege of being your life partner? Would you let me walk by your side, care for your heart, celebrate your dreams, hold your hand through the easy days and the hard ones, build a home with you, and write, together, every chapter God still has in store for us?
home.card_letters_desc: What we didn't say out loud

phrases: With you, until the last chapter.
Every day with you is a new reason.
Our story is still my favorite.
There's no rush when it's with you.
I choose you today, like the first day.
Thank you for walking beside me.
With you, even simple things feel beautiful.
